'''Gargon''' was a wealthy [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Terraforming/Legends|terraformed]] to his own specifications. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he faked his own [[Death/Legends|death]] and invited his heirs to his mansion to find a worthy inheritor. During this time, he disguised himself as his [[butler]], [[Jeeves]].
